/// Hibernate `@Cascade(SAVE_UPDATE)` for an `Extent` referenced by a tile
/// grid: insert when transient, otherwise update in place (stale ids fail).
async fn cascade_extent(tx: &Transaction<'_>, alloc: &tokio_postgres::Client, e: &mut Extent, sess: &SessionIds) -> WR<()> {
    let (llx, lly) = match &e.lower_left {
        Some((x, y)) => (Some(*x), Some(*y)),
        None => (None, None),
    };
    let (urx, ury) = match &e.upper_right {
        Some((x, y)) => (Some(*x), Some(*y)),
        None => (None, None),
    };
    match e.id {
        None => {
            let id = crate::db::allocate_id(alloc).await.map_err(WriteErr::from)?;
            e.id = Some(id);
            tx.execute(
                "INSERT INTO extents (id, created, modified, lowerleft_x, lowerleft_y, upperright_x, upperright_y) \
                 VALUES ($1, now(), now(), $2, $3, $4, $5)",
                &[&id, &llx, &lly, &urx, &ury],
            )
            .await?;
            Ok(())
        }
        Some(id) => {
            if sess.extents.contains(&id) {
                return Err(WriteErr::NonUnique);
            }
            let n = tx
                .execute(
                    "UPDATE extents SET modified = now(), lowerleft_x = $1, lowerleft_y = $2, \
                     upperright_x = $3, upperright_y = $4 WHERE id = $5",
                    &[&llx, &lly, &urx, &ury, &id],
                )
                .await?;
            if n != 1 {
                return Err(WriteErr::Stale);
            }
            Ok(())
        }
    }
}

/// Hibernate `@Cascade(SAVE_UPDATE)` for a tile grid referenced by a layer
/// data source (and, recursively, its extent).
async fn cascade_tile_grid(
    tx: &Transaction<'_>,
    alloc: &tokio_postgres::Client,
    tg: &mut TileGrid,
    sess: &SessionIds,
) -> WR<()> {
    let (ox, oy) = match &tg.origin {
        Some((x, y)) => (Some(*x), Some(*y)),
        None => (None, None),
    };
    // cascade the extent first (the tile grid row references it)
    let mut ext_id: Option<i32> = None;
    if let Some(ext) = tg.extent.as_mut() {
        cascade_extent(tx, alloc, ext, sess).await?;
        ext_id = ext.id;
    }
    match tg.id {
        None => {
            let id = crate::db::allocate_id(alloc).await.map_err(WriteErr::from)?;
            tg.id = Some(id);
            tx.execute(
                "INSERT INTO tilegrids (id, created, modified, tilegridorigin_x, tilegridorigin_y, \
                 tilesize, type, tilegridextent_id) VALUES ($1, now(), now(), $2, $3, $4, $5, $6)",
                &[&id, &ox, &oy, &tg.tile_size, &tg.typ, &ext_id],
            )
            .await?;
            if tg.is_wmts {
                tx.execute("INSERT INTO wmtstilegrids (id) VALUES ($1)", &[&id]).await?;
                if let Some(mids) = &tg.matrix_ids {
                    for m in mids {
                        tx.execute(
                            "INSERT INTO wmtstilegrids_matrixids (wmtstilegrids_id, matrixids) VALUES ($1, $2)",
                            &[&id, m],
                        )
                        .await?;
                    }
                    if tg.has_null_matrix_ids {
                        tx.execute(
                            "INSERT INTO wmtstilegrids_matrixids (wmtstilegrids_id, matrixids) VALUES ($1, NULL)",
                            &[&id],
                        )
                        .await?;
                    }
                }
            }
            if let Some(res) = &tg.resolutions {
                for (i, r) in res.iter().enumerate() {
                    let idx = i as i32;
                    tx.execute(
                        "INSERT INTO tilegrid_resolution (tilegrid_id, resolution, idx) VALUES ($1, $2, $3)",
                        &[&id, r, &idx],
                    )
                    .await?;
                }
            }
            Ok(())
        }
        Some(id) => {
            if sess.tilegrids.contains(&id) {
                return Err(WriteErr::NonUnique);
            }
            let n = tx
                .execute(
                    "UPDATE tilegrids SET modified = now(), tilegridorigin_x = $1, tilegridorigin_y = $2, \
                     tilesize = $3, type = $4, tilegridextent_id = $5 WHERE id = $6",
                    &[&ox, &oy, &tg.tile_size, &tg.typ, &ext_id, &id],
                )
                .await?;
            if n != 1 {
                return Err(WriteErr::Stale);
            }
            // the deserialized instance owns its collections: replace them
            tx.execute(
                "DELETE FROM tilegrid_resolution WHERE tilegrid_id = $1",
                &[&id],
            )
            .await?;
            if let Some(res) = &tg.resolutions {
                for (i, r) in res.iter().enumerate() {
                    let idx = i as i32;
                    tx.execute(
                        "INSERT INTO tilegrid_resolution (tilegrid_id, resolution, idx) VALUES ($1, $2, $3)",
                        &[&id, r, &idx],
                    )
                    .await?;
                }
            }
            if tg.is_wmts {
                tx.execute(
                    "DELETE FROM wmtstilegrids_matrixids WHERE wmtstilegrids_id = $1",
                    &[&id],
                )
                .await?;
                if let Some(mids) = &tg.matrix_ids {
                    for m in mids {
                        tx.execute(
                            "INSERT INTO wmtstilegrids_matrixids (wmtstilegrids_id, matrixids) VALUES ($1, $2)",
                            &[&id, m],
                        )
                        .await?;
                    }
                    if tg.has_null_matrix_ids {
                        tx.execute(
                            "INSERT INTO wmtstilegrids_matrixids (wmtstilegrids_id, matrixids) VALUES ($1, NULL)",
                            &[&id],
                        )
                        .await?;
                    }
                }
            }
            Ok(())
        }
    }
}

/// Spring Security BCrypt pattern:
/// `^\$2(a|y|b)?\$(\d\d)\$[./0-9A-Za-z]{53}$` (full match).
fn looks_like_bcrypt(hash: &str) -> bool {
    let b = hash.as_bytes();
    if b.len() < 2 || b[0] != b'$' || b[1] != b'2' {
        return false;
    }
    let mut i = 2;
    if b.get(2).is_some_and(|c| matches!(c, b'a' | b'y' | b'b')) {
        i = 3;
    }
    // $<cost>$<53 chars of the base64 alphabet>
    let rest = if b.len() == i + 1 + 2 + 1 + 53 {
        &b[i + 4..]
    } else {
        return false;
    };
    if b[i] != b'$' || !b[i + 1].is_ascii_digit() || !b[i + 2].is_ascii_digit() || b[i + 3] != b'$' {
        return false;
    }
    rest.len() == 53 && rest.iter().all(|c| c.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || *c == b'.' || *c == b'/')

pub fn parse_basic(authorization: Option<&str>) -> Option<(String, String)> {
    let h = authorization?;
    let rest = h.strip_prefix("Basic ")?;
    // non-padded / garbage input: authentication failure (401)

    let s = String::from_utf8(decoded).ok()?;
    let idx = s.find(':')?;

fn base64_decode(s: &str) -> Option<Vec<u8>> {
    let mut out = Vec::new();
    let mut acc: u32 = 0;
    let mut bits = 0;
    for c in s.chars() {
        if c == '=' {
            break;
        }
        let v = match c {
            'A'..='Z' => c as u32 - 'A' as u32,
            'a'..='z' => c as u32 - 'a' as u32 + 26,
            '0'..='9' => c as u32 - '0' as u32 + 52,
            '+' => 62,
            '/' => 63,
            _ => return None,

        acc = (acc << 6) | v;
        bits += 6;
        if bits >= 8 {
            bits -= 8;
            out.push(((acc >> bits) & 0xFF) as u8);
        }
    }
    Some(out)

pub enum Permission {
    Admin,
    Create,
    Delete,
    Update,
    Read,
}

/// `EntityPermissionEvaluatorFactory` dispatch, expressed per REST resource.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq)]
pub enum SecKind {
    User,
    UserGroup,
    Role,
    Layer,
    LayerDataSource,
    LayerAppearance,
}

/// `PersistentObjectPermissionEvaluator.hasPermission` on top of the
/// per-kind rules of the library's evaluators.
pub async fn has_permission(
    client: &Client,
    auth: &AuthUser,
    entity_id: i32,
    kind: SecKind,
    perm: Permission,
) -> Result<bool, tokio_postgres::Error> {
    // AlwaysAllowReadPermissionEvaluator types:
    if matches!(kind, SecKind::Role | SecKind::LayerDataSource | SecKind::LayerAppearance)
        && perm == Permission::Read
    {
        return Ok(true);
    }
    // UserPermissionEvaluator: READ is always granted on the own user object
    if kind == SecKind::User && perm == Permission::Read && auth.id == entity_id {
        return Ok(true);
    }
    // UserGroupPermissionEvaluator: READ for members
    if kind == SecKind::UserGroup && perm == Permission::Read {
        let rows = client
            .query(
                "SELECT 1 FROM user_usergroup WHERE user_id = $1 AND usergroup_id = $2",
                &[&auth.id, &entity_id],
            )
            .await?;
        if !rows.is_empty() {
            return Ok(true);
        }
    }
    // user permission collections on the entity
    let user_perms: Vec<String> = client
        .query(
            "SELECT pcp.permissions FROM userpermissions up \
             JOIN permissioncollections_permissions pcp ON pcp.permissioncollections_id = up.userpermissions_id \
             WHERE up.entity_id = $1 AND up.userpermissions_key = $2",
            &[&entity_id, &auth.id],
        )
        .await?
        .iter()
        .map(|r| r.get(0))
        .collect();
    if perms_grant(&user_perms, perm) {
        return Ok(true);
    }
    // group permission collections (aggregated over the user's groups)
    let group_ids: Vec<i32> = client
        .query(
            "SELECT usergroup_id FROM user_usergroup WHERE user_id = $1",
            &[&auth.id],
        )
        .await?
        .iter()
        .map(|r| r.get(0))
        .collect();
    if !group_ids.is_empty() {
        let group_perms: Vec<String> = client
            .query(
                "SELECT pcp.permissions FROM grouppermissions gp \
                 JOIN permissioncollections_permissions pcp ON pcp.permissioncollections_id = gp.grouppermissions_id \
                 WHERE gp.entity_id = $1 AND gp.grouppermissions_key = ANY($2)",
                &[&entity_id, &group_ids],
            )
            .await?
            .iter()
            .map(|r| r.get(0))
            .collect();
        if perms_grant(&group_perms, perm) {
            return Ok(true);
        }
    }
    Ok(false)
}

fn perms_grant(perms: &[String], perm: Permission) -> bool {
    let wanted = match perm {
        Permission::Admin => "ADMIN",
        Permission::Create => "CREATE",
        Permission::Delete => "DELETE",
        Permission::Update => "UPDATE",
        Permission::Read => "READ",
    };
    perms.iter().any(|p| p == wanted || p == "ADMIN")
}

fn req(method: &str, path: &str, auth: Option<(&str, &str)>, body: Option<&str>) -> Req {
    let (path_only, query) = match path.split_once('?') {
        Some((p, q)) => (p, q),
        None => (path, ""),
    };
    let mut r = Req::get(method, path_only);
    if let Some((u, p)) = auth {
        let creds = format!("{}:{}", u, p);
        const T: &[u8] =
            b"ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/";
        let b = creds.as_bytes();
        let mut enc = String::new();
        for chunk in b.chunks(3) {
            let mut n = 0u32;
            for (i, x) in chunk.iter().enumerate() {
                n |= (*x as u32) << (16 - 8 * i);
            }
            let has = chunk.len();
            enc.push(T[((n >> 18) & 63) as usize] as char);
            enc.push(T[((n >> 12) & 63) as usize] as char);
            enc.push(if has > 1 { T[((n >> 6) & 63) as usize] as char } else { '=' });
            enc.push(if has > 2 { T[(n & 63) as usize] as char } else { '=' });
        }
        r.headers.push(("authorization".into(), format!("Basic {}", enc)));
    }
    if let Some(b) = body {
        r.body = b.as_bytes().to_vec();
    }
    r.query = lib_parse_query(query);

}

fn lib_parse_query(q: &str) -> Vec<(String, String)> {
    let mut out = Vec::new();
    for part in q.split('&') {
        if part.is_empty() {
            continue;
        }
        let (k, v) = match part.split_once('=') {
            Some((k, v)) => (k, v),
            None => (part, ""),
        };
        out.push((lib::handlers::url_decode(k), lib::handlers::url_decode(v)));
    }
    out
}
